name: Spiritual Letters to One of His Converts
name_pt: Cartas Espirituais a Um de Seus Convertidos
desc: Extracts from Benson's letters (1915) to one of his converts, in six parts: Anglican letters, early Catholic letters, letters from Rome, letters of spiritual direction, to one beginning a literary career, and to one entering religion.
desc_pt: Trechos das cartas de Benson (1915) a um de seus convertidos, em seis partes: cartas anglicanas, primeiras cartas católicas, cartas de Roma, cartas de direção espiritual, a quem inicia uma carreira literária e a quem entra na vida religiosa.
edition: Spiritual Letters to One of His Converts (London: Longmans, Green, 1915), Internet Archive full-text OCR (spiritualletters00bensuoft).
manual: V. To One Beginning a Literary Career
